data.body: Resume update after orchestrator unblock: plan-review currency is still certified/current; rebased onto origin/main 6b034b9f8224; sanitized full pre-flight `env GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=4 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_3=safe.bareRepository GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_3=all PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make test` passed; `make lint`, `make typecheck`, focused deprecation suite, and commit-ticket verification passed. Gerrit change 2605 is current at patch set 6 / commit 5f6dbbec5bdc with LLM-Review satisfied, but Verified remains blocked by the unrelated scanner-integration failure: `ERROR: could not execute .tools/review-scanners/bin/semgrep`. The files implicated by that failure are outside this ticket's authorized file_impact (at minimum `scripts/install_review_scanners.py` and/or `Makefile` scanner-integration plumbing). Per scope protocol I am not editing those files and cannot land/close until Verified is green. No --force used.
